_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for this storefront's look + content. To clone this template into a NEW store: copy the app, then edit THIS file (brand, colors, font sizes, nav, hero, tiles, testimonials). No component code changes needed. Font sizes are real CSS sizes (rem/px/clamp) — tune them here.
